# TGAYS Technology
# https://www.tgaystechnology.com

> TGAYS Technology Pvt. Ltd. is a global software development and digital transformation company providing AI-powered solutions, web development, mobile app development, CRM development, SaaS development, custom software development, IT staff augmentation, offshore development, digital marketing, and application support services.

AI Powered Services

Mobile App Development
Description:
Android applications, iOS applications, cross-platform mobile apps, React Native development, and enterprise mobility solutions.

Custom Software Development
Description:
Tailor-made software applications, enterprise systems, workflow automation, and business process management systems.

CRM Development
Description:
Customer Relationship Management systems, sales automation, lead management, customer support systems, and workflow management.

SaaS Development
Description:
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cloud software solutions, subscription management systems, and software product engineering.

Product Development
Description:
End-to-end software product development, architecture planning, MVP creation, and product lifecycle management.

MVP Development
Description:
Rapid MVP development for startups, validation platforms, prototype development, and scalable architecture.

IT Staff Augmentation
Description:
Dedicated developers, QA engineers, UI/UX designers, project managers, and remote technology teams.

Offshore Development
Description:
Managed offshore development centers, dedicated teams, and long-term software partnerships.

Application Support
Description:
Software maintenance, performance monitoring, bug fixing, upgrades, and support services.

Digital Marketing
Description:
SEO, GEO, AEO, PPC, content marketing, lead generation, online branding, and digital growth solutions.

Social Media Marketing
Description:
Facebook marketing, Instagram marketing, LinkedIn marketing, social media management, and paid advertising campaigns.

M365 Development
Description:
Microsoft 365 integrations, SharePoint development, Power Apps, Power Automate, and business productivity solutions.
